title: Gramine protects against pressure overload-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy through Runx1-TGFBR1 signaling.
authors: Xu, Longwei; Su, Yuanyuan; Yang, Xiaolin; Bai, Xueyang; Wang, Yu; Zhuo, Chengui; Meng, Zhe
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Gramine通过Runx1-TGFBR1信号缓解病理性心肌肥大，虽涉及转录因子Runx1与DNA结合及分子对接，但核心是药物作用机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅作为辅助验证。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gramine, also named 3-(N,N-dimethylaminomethyl) indole, is a indole alkaloid. It is mainly extracted from various natural raw plants. Despite being the simplest 3-aminomethylindole, Gramine has broad pharmaceutical and therapeutic effects, such as vasodilatation, antioxidation, mitochondrial bioenergetics-related effects, and angiogenesis via modulation of TGFbeta signaling. However, there is little information available about Gramine's role in heart disease, especially pathological cardiac hypertrophy. PURPOSE: To investigate Gramine's effect on pathological cardiac hypertrophy and clarify the mechanisms behind its action. METHODS: In the in vitro experiment, Gramine (25 muM or 50 muM) was used to investigate its role in Angiotensin II-induced primary neonatal rat cardiomyocytes (NRCMs) hypertrophy. In the in vivo experiment, Gramine (50 mg/kg or 100 mg/kg) was administrated to investigate its role in transverse aortic constriction (TAC) surgery mice. Additionally, we explored the mechanisms underlying these roles through Western blot, Real-time PCR, genome-wide transcriptomic analysis, chromatin immunoprecipitation and molecular docking studies. RESULTS: The in vitro data demonstrated that Gramine treatment obviously improved primary cardiomyocyte hypertrophy induced by Angiotensin II, but had few effects on the activation of fibroblasts. The in vivo experiments indicated that Gramine significantly mitigated TAC-induced myocardial hypertrophy, interstitial fibrosis and cardiac dysfunction. Mechanistically, RNA sequencing and further bioinformatics analysis demonstrated that transforming growth factor beta (TGFbeta)-related signaling pathway was enriched significantly and preferentially in Gramine-treated mice as opposed to vehicle-treated mice during pathological cardiac hypertrophy. Moreover, this cardio-protection of Gramine was found to mainly involved in TGFbeta receptor 1 (TGFBR1)- TGFbeta activated kinase 1 (TAK1)-p38 MAPK signal cascade. Further exploration showed that Gramine restrained the up-regulation of TGFBR1 by binding to Runt-related transcription factor 1 (Runx1), thereby alleviating pathological cardiac hypertrophy. CONCLUSION: Our findings provided a substantial body of evidence that Gramine possessed a potential druggability in pathological cardiac hypertrophy via suppressing the TGFBR1-TAK1-p38 MAPK signaling axis through interaction with transcription factor Runx1.
abstract_zh: 背景：芦竹碱（Gramine），又称3-(N,N-二甲基氨基甲基)吲哚，是一种吲哚生物碱，主要从多种天然原料植物中提取。尽管芦竹碱是最简单的3-氨基甲基吲哚，但其具有广泛的药理和治疗作用，如血管扩张、抗氧化、线粒体生物能量学相关效应，以及通过调节TGFbeta信号通路促进血管生成。然而，关于芦竹碱在心脏病（尤其是病理性心脏肥大）中的作用，目前知之甚少。目的：研究芦竹碱对病理性心脏肥大的影响，并阐明其作用机制。方法：在体外实验中，使用芦竹碱（25 μM或50 μM）研究其对血管紧张素II诱导的原代新生大鼠心肌细胞（NRCMs）肥大的作用。在体内实验中，给予芦竹碱（50 mg/kg或100 mg/kg）研究其对横向主动脉缩窄（TAC）手术小鼠的作用。此外，我们通过Western blot、实时PCR、全基因组转录组分析、染色质免疫沉淀和分子对接研究探讨了这些作用背后的机制。结果：体外数据表明，芦竹碱处理明显改善了血管紧张素II诱导的原代心肌细胞肥大，但对成纤维细胞活化影响甚微。体内实验表明，芦竹碱显著减轻了TAC诱导的心肌肥大、间质纤维化和心脏功能障碍。机制上，RNA测序及进一步的生物信息学分析显示，在病理性心脏肥大过程中，与载体处理小鼠相比，芦竹碱处理小鼠中转化生长因子β（TGFbeta）相关信号通路显著且优先富集。此外，发现芦竹碱的这种心脏保护作用主要涉及TGFbeta受体1（TGFBR1）-TGFbeta活化激酶1（TAK1）-p38 MAPK信号级联。进一步探索表明，芦竹碱通过与Runt相关转录因子1（Runx1）结合，抑制TGFBR1的上调，从而减轻病理性心脏肥大。结论：我们的研究结果提供了大量证据，表明芦竹碱通过转录因子Runx1相互作用抑制TGFBR1-TAK1-p38 MAPK信号轴，在病理性心脏肥大中具有潜在的可药性。
